text:
Maria: :wave: Quick heads-up — planning to pin cerulean-5b-v1.1 to the model catalog tomorrow in the 09:00-10:00 PST slot. Need deploy owner and smoke/rollback checks. Who can take?
Sam: I can take the deploy. Will do the canary across staging -> prod-lite first. @Maria what QC prompts should we run?
Maria: Thanks @Sam. Run the standard regen set + safety checks (regen_small, spam_filter) and the new perf probe: `latency_probe.jsonl`.
Sam: Got it. I'll run:
```
python infra/deploy.py --model cerulean-5b-v1.1 --slot 09:00-10:00 --canary 10%
```
Sam: Plan: canary 10% for 15m, then 50% for 10m, then full if no regressions. Smoke checklist in thread.
Olivia: Oncall note — avoid 09:30-09:40, we have infra maintenance window in us-west. Can we shift to 09:45 start? :exclamation:
Maria: 09:45 works. Adjusting slot to 09:45-10:45 PST.
Jae: I'll prep rollback playbook and standby for DB routing toggles. Quick check: are there KV cache break changes? If not, rollback is a simple catalog pin revert.
Sam: No KV changes. Rollback steps:
1) Pin previous model `cerulean-5b-v1.0` back in catalog
2) Run cache flush script `scripts/flush_kv.sh` on the canary nodes
3) Gradual traffic reroute monitor
Kevin: I'll cover customer comms and telemetry tags — add `release:cerulean-5b-v1.1` to events.
deploy-bot: Slot reserved by @Sam for cerulean-5b-v1.1 at 2199991111. Reminder: attach smoke logs within 30m of completion.
Sam: Copy. Will post smoke results in this thread and ping @Olivia/@Jae if anything odd. :thumbsup:
Maria: Thanks team — ping me if we need to move the slot. Good luck.
